mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, which triggers a forward-looking monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers a policy response and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 98.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong aggregate demand, which raises inflation expectations and triggers a forward-looking monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise above their 90th percentiles, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflation that forces central banks to maintain restrictive policy, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a forward-looking monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures combined with a rising GDP growth rate signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflationary pressure and leads to a forward-looking monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and GDPC1 are above their 90th percentiles, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
